objective: Build the We Remember MVP with consent-first data boundaries and deterministic consequential workflows

waves.description: Freeze shared data, API, consent, visibility, state-machine, and fixture contracts before implementation

tasks.title: Freeze the MVP contracts and architecture baseline
tasks.spec: Define the first-class five-stage Task fields, consent and visibility rules, handover and care state machines, API boundaries, JSON Schemas, failure semantics, and representative contract examples. Do not implement product code.
acceptance: Task ownership stages are persisted fields rather than view-time inference
Private agent_dm content cannot cross into shared data without explicit speaker consent
Handover remains blocked until information is complete and both parties confirm
Care escalation is deterministic and care rules require human activation
All structured AI outputs have schemas and blocked-by-default failure semantics

waves.description: Build isolated consumers from the accepted architecture SHA

tasks.title: Build the role-specific accessible web experience
tasks.spec: Consume the frozen contracts to implement the primary, partner, and subject experiences, including consent, neutral responsibility reporting, blocked handover, evidence access, and accessible care acknowledgement.
acceptance: Primary, partner, and subject home experiences remain distinct
Subject UI meets the PRD accessibility constraints
Blocked state and consent visibility are explicit
No blame, score, ranking, or diagnostic language is introduced

tasks.title: Build the application API boundary
tasks.spec: Expose the frozen application contract with input validation, authorization boundaries, explicit error states, and no secret leakage.
acceptance: Requests and responses conform to the frozen schemas
Authorization is enforced at every shared-data boundary
Errors preserve blocked, failed, and partial truth instead of defaulting to success

tasks.title: Build schema-validated AI drafting services
tasks.spec: Implement witness, responsibility-domain, handover, and boundary-agent drafts behind the frozen interfaces. Send only the minimum necessary redacted context and validate all structured output.
acceptance: All structured output is schema validated
One retry is bounded and a second failure degrades to human confirmation
Prompt versions, latency, and token usage are auditable without logging sensitive content
The boundary agent cannot bypass deterministic authorization

tasks.title: Build consent, responsibility, and handover domain rules
tasks.spec: Implement deterministic consent, visibility, five-stage ownership, responsibility aggregation, handover, deletion, and audit rules from the frozen contract.
acceptance: Private-to-shared transitions require explicit speaker consent
Accepted handover requires complete information and two confirmations
Evidence deletion marks dependent conclusions and triggers recomputation
Audit records cover consequential transitions

tasks.title: Build the deterministic care escalation state machine
tasks.spec: Implement human-confirmed care rules, acknowledgement timeouts, escalation, closure, and unresolved evidence without any LLM in the consequential execution path.
acceptance: Draft care rules cannot activate without human confirmation
Reminder, acknowledgement, timeout, escalation, closure, and unresolved paths are deterministic
High-risk content is routed to explicit safety guidance without diagnosis

tasks.title: Build fixtures and end-to-end acceptance
tasks.spec: Create fictional but representative fixtures and acceptance coverage for consent, visibility, neutral reporting, blocked handover, care escalation, deletion, failure, and high-risk boundaries.
acceptance: The fixture includes at least three responsibility domains and eight valid signals
At least two discussion-only messages are rejected as tasks
Success and representative failure paths identify the owning track
Fixtures contain no real personal data or secrets

waves.description: Merge accepted task SHAs exactly and validate the complete demo flow

tasks.title: Assemble and verify the release candidate
tasks.spec: Start from the accepted architecture baseline, merge each accepted dependency SHA with a clean no-ff merge, stop on any conflict, and make assembly-only changes within integration-owned paths.
acceptance: Every accepted dependency SHA is an exact second parent of a no-ff merge
The consent-to-handover-to-care demo path is reproducible
Representative failure and privacy boundaries pass
Release evidence distinguishes local validation from deployment or submission proof
